measure_library.name: HVAC temperature-band or precooling screen
measure_library.mechanism: Shift sensible cooling electricity away from a selected event period; quantify rebound rather than assume benefit.
measure_library.minimum_inputs: HVAC configuration, schedules, interval electricity, tariff, allowed temperature band
measure_library.approval_gate: Facilities and operations review; no automatic setpoint change

measure_library.name: Lighting-schedule screen
measure_library.mechanism: Test a bounded schedule reduction during a selected event window.
measure_library.minimum_inputs: Lighting inventory, operating/merchandising requirements, interval electricity, tariff
measure_library.approval_gate: Operations, visual-task, security, and safety review

measure_library.name: Schedule and load-shape audit
measure_library.mechanism: Compare interval-load features with documented hours and equipment schedules to find a data or schedule discrepancy.
measure_library.minimum_inputs: Interval electricity, store hours, major-equipment schedule, meter boundary
measure_library.approval_gate: Confirm with facilities before changing schedules

measure_library.name: Refrigeration control
measure_library.mechanism: Not evaluated by the public demo.
measure_library.minimum_inputs: Authorized refrigeration representation, monitoring data, food-safety constraints, qualified review
measure_library.approval_gate: Separate authorization and safety review required
